scope: Independent source review only; no browser, build, or tests were run.

short_page_exhaustion.evidence: The runner marks exhaustion only after an observed response has fewer raw rows than its requested limit. A full page with no usable Load more control fails as pagination unavailable, and page-budget exhaustion remains distinct.
short_page_exhaustion.limit: No live list response was observed; exhaustion behavior remains runtime-unverified.

later_page_request_binding.evidence: Each captured list GET is checked for the URL alias, integer limit, exact created_at.desc,id.desc order, expected cursor, stable limit, and stable origin. The expected later-page cursor is derived from the last visible card and matched uniquely to a raw response row. The app query uses that same created_at/id keyset and page order.
later_page_request_binding.limit: No later-page response was observed. The runner skips duplicate IDs but does not independently prove response-page progression or disjointness; this review verifies the requested cursor/query contract, not backend cursor compliance.

discovery_deadline.evidence: One deadline is created for discovery. List waits, settled-pagination waits, UI clicks/evaluation, and candidate DNS classification are raced against remaining time; each DNS timeout is capped by both the configured DNS limit and remaining discovery time.
discovery_deadline.limit: Promise.race bounds the runner wait but does not cancel an underlying DNS lookup or operation. The separate fixture-navigation guard has its own DNS preflight and is outside the discovery deadline.

readonly_scope.evidence: The runner performs no Source Save/Capture action and imports no Source write or checkpoint path. Its filesystem writes are the local acceptance result. Before public fixture navigation, a fresh page has scripts disabled, service workers bypassed, and a route guard allowing only public HTTPS GET/HEAD requests after address checks.
readonly_scope.limit: This supports a scoped no-Source-write test design, not a general claim that every GET is side-effect-free or a DNS-rebinding guarantee. Authentication and organization selection are outside the public fixture page guard.

runtime_evidence: None in this review. Do not claim native D22 acceptance, a discovered qualifying fixture, a later-page pass, or defect closure from this source review.
